raw_comment:
I notice that the general area of central US has the most areas with extreme and exceptional droughts. There are lots of dark colors in the middle of the US, which means the most droughts. I noticed that the east coast and the top of the west coast have the highest colors of yellow and white. This means that they have the least amount of droughts, or very mild droughts. This could be due to the fact that they border the oceans, and they are on the water.  I wonder what is causing the great amount of serious droughts in central US. I wonder what this exact graph looked like 5 years ago, and what they predict the drought pattern to be in 5 years. It would be interesting to see if the droughts in the US are getting worse, or improving. This relates to me and my community because I live in the US, and I travel to different states a lot, so it is important to see what states are going through severe droughts, and the causes for this as well. This also affects me because these conditions can affect the water supply in the country, and food supply, which are both crucial factors for survival.
